catalog.name: Nostoi
catalog.short: Tamper-evident audit chains: verify, append, stream and browse them. One format for every chain.
catalog.value: A chain is a sequence of records where each carries the digest of the record before it and a digest of its own content. Verification names the first inconsistent record. Nostoi is a Rust library, a CLI and a TUI for that, and it already reads the chains the RAGBAZ projects keep — Nostoi's own, WeftMark's ledger and Ephor's audit chain — so the rest of a fleet can share one format. Detecting a removed tail or a wholly recomputed history still requires a head trusted outside the chain, which is what signed anchors are for.
